item.title: 14-year-old arrested in sexual battery of 91-year-old Reddick woman, sheriff says
item.description: Authorities in Marion County have made an arrest in a home intrusion and rape investigation in which a 91-year-old Reddick woman was awakened from her sleep and assaulted, detectives said.

item.title: System in Gulf set to become Tropical Storm Alberto, the first named storm of the 2024 hurricane season
item.description: The National Hurricane Center has issued tropical storm warnings ahead of future Tropical Storm Alberto, which is likely to form on Wednesday in the southwestern Gulf of Mexico.

item.title: Man attacked by alligator while swimming in Seminole County lake, FWC investigating
item.description: Wildlife officials are investigating after a man was reportedly bitten by an alligator while swimming in a Seminole County lake, according to the Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (FWC).

item.title: 'Squiggly shark' with 'rare' deformity hooked in Titusville: 'I feel bad keeping this one'
item.description: A “squiggly shark" with an apparent tail deformity was discovered in Titusville earlier this month – and researchers have revealed a possible explanation to why the big fish looks the way it does.

item.title: Florida man admits to burning bodies of missing family of 4: affidavit
item.description: A Florida man was taken to jail after he allegedly admitted to burning the bodies of a missing family of four.

item.title: Southwest Airlines celebrates 53rd birthday with $53 one-way tickets
item.description: Southwest Airlines is celebrating its 53rd birthday by offering one-way tickets for as low as $53.

item.title: Boeing Starliner departure from space station remains delayed due to 'complicated' issues
item.description: Boeing Starliner's first astronaut crew will spend an additional week in orbit as ground teams complete more data reviews of ongoing issues with the spacecraft.

item.title: 1 person killed, another injured in Alachua County crash: FHP
item.description: On Tuesday afternoon, one person was killed after a crash in Alachua County, according to the Florida Highway Patrol.

item.title: Accused Orange County serial law enforcement impersonator out on bond; deputies search for possible victims
item.description: Christopher Levins, a 26-year-old man accused of being a serial law enforcement impersonator, has been released on bond, according to the Orange County Sheriff’s Office.
